# TKDG Labs

> TKDG Labs Co., Ltd. is an Incheon, Korea-based brand launch and content growth company integrating brand strategy, content channel operations, and visual production.

## Company
- Legal name: 티케이디지랩스 주식회사 (TKDG Labs Co., Ltd.)
- Founded: 2025-02-17
- Website: https://tkdglabs.com/
- Location: 인천광역시 서구 파랑로 451, 10층 1010호

## Core Services
- Brand Launch Strategy: brand naming, positioning, tone and manner, customer experience, launch direction
- Content Growth System: YouTube, blog, SNS, content calendar, production workflow, performance reporting
- Visual Production: profile, space, product, interview video, and content-ready visual assets

## Representative Project Types
- Brand launch and rebranding for professional service, clinic, corporate, and franchise clients
- Monthly content channel operations through Turnkeyhaus by TKDG
- Brand visual production through Pic_sta by TKDG
- Internal content team workflow setup and production standardization

## Brand Units
- TKDG Labs: Parent brand and strategy organization for brand launch systems
- Turnkeyhaus by TKDG: YouTube, blog, SNS, and content channel operations
- Pic_sta by TKDG: Space, profile, and brand visual production

## Target Clients
- Clinics and hospitals preparing brand or content operations
- Law firms and professional service brands that need trust-building content
- Companies and franchises preparing a brand launch or channel growth system
